strings: m_c doesn't want to look at {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} leg. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} can no longer feel it at all and it has begun to smell of rot. r_c says that it's probably best to remove it now before it gets worse, and m_c can't help but agree.
r_c tells m_c that the frostbite is far too severe. The leg will have to be removed completely.

m_c awoke with one less leg than {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} went to sleep with. Admittedly, it's more of a relief than anything. {PRONOUN/m_c/poss/CAP} dead, frostbitten flesh no longer had any feeling left anyway.
